description: This module allows the administration of Keycloak components using the Keycloak REST API. It requires access to the REST API using OpenID Connect; the user connecting and the realm being used must have the requisite access rights. In a default Keycloak installation, admin-cli and an admin user would work, as would a separate realm definition with the scope tailored to your needs and a user having the expected roles.

parameters.name: auth_client_id
parameters.description: OpenID Connect client_id to authenticate to the API with. Default: "admin-cli"

parameters.name: auth_client_secret
parameters.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with auth_client_id (if required).

parameters.name: auth_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: auth_realm
parameters.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

parameters.name: auth_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Configuration properties for the provider. Contents vary depending on the provider type.

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API. Default: 10

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the component to create.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: The parent_id of the component. In practice the ID (name) of the realm.

parameters.name: provider_id
parameters.description: The name of the “provider ID” for the key.

parameters.name: provider_type
parameters.description: The name of the “provider type” for the key. That is, org.keycloak.storage.UserStorageProvider, org.keycloak.userprofile.UserProfileProvider, … See https://www.keycloak.org/docs/latest/server_development/index.html#_providers.

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the Keycloak component. On present, the component is created (or updated if it exists already). On absent, the component is removed if it exists. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Manage Keycloak User Storage Provider
  community.general.keycloak_component:
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_username: keycloak
    auth_password: keycloak
    auth_realm: master
    name: my storage provider
    state: present
    parent_id: some_realm
    provider_id: my storage
    provider_type: "org.keycloak.storage.UserStorageProvider"
    config:
      myCustomKey: "my_custom_key"
      cachePolicy: "NO_CACHE"
      enabled: true

return_values.name: end_state
return_values.description: Representation of the keycloak_component after module execution. Returned: on success

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: ID of the component. Returned: when state=present Sample: "5b7ec13f-99da-46ad-8326-ab4c73cf4ce4"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the component. Returned: when state=present Sample: "mykey"

return_values.name: parentId
return_values.description: ID of the realm this key belongs to. Returned: when state=present Sample: "myrealm"

return_values.name: providerId
return_values.description: The ID of the key provider. Returned: when state=present Sample: "rsa"

return_values.name: providerType
return_values.description: The type of provider. Returned: when state=present
